edits.current: "subtype": "Pass the primitive base value, including inside Array, List, Option, Prod and Except containers using their generated host representations. Each present Subtype leaf uses the selected checked Lean constructor; accepted normalization reaches the export. A rejected leaf fails the call without changing the input; later valid calls still work. Results expose the proof-backed base values. Transparent aliases and the tested closed List specialization keep their constructor choices. In Node, checked fields retain the declared primitive's host representation across all nineteen tested bases: undefined (void in TypeScript) for Unit, boolean for Bool, bigint for UInt64, Int64, Nat and Int, string for String and Char, Uint8Array for ByteArray, and number for the other fixed-width integers, floats and wasm32 machine words. Each input site keeps its selected checked constructor and accepted normalization; only the active variant branch is checked. Rejection preserves caller values and later valid calls succeed. Copied results project existing Lean payloads without proof fields or input constructor selections, including standalone result-only packages. GenericNat is the concrete GenericCarrier Nat alias: its value field crosses without a proof, each named specialization retains its selected plusOne or plusTwo constructor, and copied results carry no constructor."

edits.current: "subtype": "Pass the primitive base value, including inside Array, List, Option, Prod and Except containers using their generated host representations. Each present Subtype leaf uses the selected checked Lean constructor; accepted normalization reaches the export. A rejected leaf fails the call without changing the input; later valid calls still work. Results expose the proof-backed base values. Transparent aliases and the tested closed List specialization keep their constructor choices. In Node, checked fields retain the declared primitive's host representation across all nineteen tested bases: undefined (void in TypeScript) for Unit, boolean for Bool, bigint for UInt64, Int64, Nat and Int, string for String and Char, Uint8Array for ByteArray, and number for the other fixed-width integers, floats and wasm32 machine words. Each input site keeps its selected checked constructor and accepted normalization; only the active variant branch is checked. Rejection preserves caller values and later valid calls succeed. Copied results project existing Lean payloads without proof fields or input constructor selections, including standalone result-only packages. GenericNat is the concrete GenericCarrier Nat alias: its value field crosses without a proof, each named specialization retains its selected plusOne or plusTwo constructor, and copied results carry no constructor."

edits.current: "subtype": "Pass the primitive base value, including inside Array, List, Option, Prod and Except containers using their generated host representations. Each present Subtype leaf uses the selected checked Lean constructor; accepted normalization reaches the export. A rejected leaf fails the call without changing the input; later valid calls still work. Results expose the proof-backed base values. Transparent aliases and the tested closed List specialization keep their constructor choices. In C/C++, checked fields retain the declared primitive's public host type across all nineteen tested bases. C structs use fixed-width scalars, GMP integers and length-aware string/byte spans with explicit ownership; C++ values use fixed-width scalars, boost::multiprecision::cpp_int, std::string and std::vector<uint8_t>. Unit, Bool, Char, floats and native words keep their ordinary generated representations. Each input site keeps its selected checked constructor and accepted normalization; only the active variant branch is checked. Rejection preserves caller values and later valid calls succeed. C also preserves existing output payloads, tags and ownership on rejection. Copied results project existing Lean payloads without proof fields or input constructor selections, including standalone result-only packages. GenericNat is the concrete GenericCarrier Nat alias: its value field crosses without a proof, each named specialization retains its selected plusOne or plusTwo constructor, and copied results carry no constructor."

edits.current: "subtype": "Pass the primitive base value, including inside Array, List, Option, Prod and Except containers using their generated host representations. Each present Subtype leaf uses the selected checked Lean constructor; accepted normalization reaches the export. A rejected leaf fails the call without changing the input; later valid calls still work. Results expose the proof-backed base values. Transparent aliases and the tested closed List specialization keep their constructor choices. In C/C++, checked fields retain the declared primitive's public host type across all nineteen tested bases. C structs use fixed-width scalars, GMP integers and length-aware string/byte spans with explicit ownership; C++ values use fixed-width scalars, boost::multiprecision::cpp_int, std::string and std::vector<uint8_t>. Unit, Bool, Char, floats and native words keep their ordinary generated representations. Each input site keeps its selected checked constructor and accepted normalization; only the active variant branch is checked. Rejection preserves caller values and later valid calls succeed. C also preserves existing output payloads, tags and ownership on rejection. Copied results project existing Lean payloads without proof fields or input constructor selections, including standalone result-only packages. GenericNat is the concrete GenericCarrier Nat alias: its value field crosses without a proof, each named specialization retains its selected plusOne or plusTwo constructor, and copied results carry no constructor."

edits.current: "subtype": "Pass the primitive base value, including inside Array, List, Option, Prod and Except containers using their generated host representations. Each present Subtype leaf uses the selected checked Lean constructor; accepted normalization reaches the export. A rejected leaf fails the call without changing the input; later valid calls still work. Results expose the proof-backed base values. Transparent aliases and the tested closed List specialization keep their constructor choices. In Perl, checked fields retain the declared primitive's host representation across all nineteen tested bases: undef for Unit, the generated native boolean for Bool, IV or UV scalars for fixed-width integers and native machine words, Math::BigInt for Nat and Int, NV scalars for Float32 and Float, and strings for String, Char and ByteArray. Generated blessed wrappers carry the record and variant fields. Each input site keeps its selected checked constructor and accepted normalization; only the active variant branch is checked. Rejection preserves caller values and later valid calls succeed. Copied results project existing Lean payloads without proof fields or input constructor selections, including standalone result-only packages. GenericNat is the concrete GenericCarrier Nat alias: its value field crosses without a proof, each named specialization retains its selected plusOne or plusTwo constructor, and copied results carry no constructor."

edits.current: "subtype": "Pass the primitive base value, including inside Array, List, Option, Prod and Except containers using their generated host representations. Each present Subtype leaf uses the selected checked Lean constructor; accepted normalization reaches the export. A rejected leaf fails the call without changing the input; later valid calls still work. Results expose the proof-backed base values. Transparent aliases and the tested closed List specialization keep their constructor choices. In Perl, checked fields retain the declared primitive's host representation across all nineteen tested bases: undef for Unit, the generated native boolean for Bool, IV or UV scalars for fixed-width integers and native machine words, Math::BigInt for Nat and Int, NV scalars for Float32 and Float, and strings for String, Char and ByteArray. Generated blessed wrappers carry the record and variant fields. Each input site keeps its selected checked constructor and accepted normalization; only the active variant branch is checked. Rejection preserves caller values and later valid calls succeed. Copied results project existing Lean payloads without proof fields or input constructor selections, including standalone result-only packages. GenericNat is the concrete GenericCarrier Nat alias: its value field crosses without a proof, each named specialization retains its selected plusOne or plusTwo constructor, and copied results carry no constructor."

edits.current: "subtype": "Pass the primitive base value, including inside Array, List, Option, Prod and Except containers using their generated host representations. Each present Subtype leaf uses the selected checked Lean constructor; accepted normalization reaches the export. A rejected leaf fails the call without changing the input; later valid calls still work. Results expose the proof-backed base values. Transparent aliases and the tested closed List specialization keep their constructor choices. In Rust, checked nominal values preserve all nineteen tested primitive representations: `()`, `bool`, matching fixed-width integers, `BigUint` for `Nat`, `BigInt` for `Int`, `f32`, `f64`, `String`, `Vec<u8>`, `char`, `u64` for `USize` and `i64` for `ISize`. Generated structs and enums carry owned record and active-variant fields; input functions borrow those aggregate values. Each input site retains its selected checked constructor and accepted normalization. Rejection preserves the complete caller value and later valid calls succeed. Copied results project proof-backed payloads without proof fields or input constructor selections, including standalone result-only crates. GenericNat is the concrete GenericCarrier Nat alias: its value field crosses without a proof, each named specialization retains its selected plusOne or plusTwo constructor, and copied results carry no constructor."

edits.current: "subtype": "Pass the primitive base value, including inside Array, List, Option, Prod and Except containers using their generated host representations. Each present Subtype leaf uses the selected checked Lean constructor; accepted normalization reaches the export. A rejected leaf fails the call without changing the input; later valid calls still work. Results expose the proof-backed base values. Transparent aliases and the tested closed List specialization keep their constructor choices. In C#, checked nominal values preserve all nineteen tested primitive representations: Unit, bool, byte, ushort, uint, ulong, sbyte, short, int, long, BigInteger for Nat and Int, float, double, string, byte[], Rune, ulong for USize and long for ISize. Generated sealed records and cases carry the record and active-variant fields. Each input site retains its selected checked constructor and accepted normalization; only the active variant branch is checked. Rejection preserves the complete caller value and later valid calls succeed. Copied results project proof-backed payloads without proof fields or input constructor selections, including standalone result-only packages. GenericNat is the concrete GenericCarrier Nat alias: its value field crosses without a proof, each named specialization retains its selected plusOne or plusTwo constructor, and copied results carry no constructor."

edits.current: "subtype": "In native PHP, checked nominal values preserve all nineteen tested primitive representations: null for Unit; bool; int for the bounded integers through UInt32 and Int64; Brick\\Math\\BigInteger for UInt64, Nat, Int and USize; float for Float32 and Float64; string for String and Char; Bytes for ByteArray; and int for 64-bit ISize. Generated final readonly classes carry record and active-variant fields without proof fields. Each input site retains its selected checked constructor and accepted normalization; only the active variant branch is checked. Fixed-width overflow, invalid Unicode scalars, malformed Bytes, non-finite floats where the contract refuses them, wrong classes and invalid Fin siblings reject before Lean dispatch. Rejection preserves the complete caller value, including signed zero and embedded NUL data, and later valid calls succeed. Copied results project proof-backed payloads without input constructor selections, including standalone result-only packages. GenericNat is the concrete GenericCarrier Nat alias: its value field crosses without a proof, each named specialization retains its selected plusOne or plusTwo constructor, and copied results carry no constructor."

Generated final readonly classes carry record and active-variant fields without proof fields. Each input site retains its selected checked constructor and accepted normalization; only the active variant branch is checked. Fixed-width overflow, invalid Unicode scalars, malformed Bytes, non-finite floats where the contract refuses them, wrong classes and invalid Fin siblings reject before Lean dispatch. Rejection preserves the complete caller value, including signed zero and embedded NUL data, and later valid calls succeed. Copied results project proof-backed payloads without input constructor selections, including standalone result-only packages. GenericNat is the concrete GenericCarrier Nat alias: its value field crosses without a proof, each named specialization retains its selected plusOne or plusTwo constructor, and copied results carry no constructor."

edits.current: "subtype": "In WIT, checked nominal values preserve all nineteen tested primitive representations through the Component Model adapter and its 64-bit native Lean host: the unit enum for Unit; bool; u8, u16, u32 and u64; s8, s16, s32 and s64; exact little-endian `list<u32>` limbs for Nat; a record of sign and limbs for Int; f32 and f64 including signed zero; string with embedded NUL; `list<u8>` for ByteArray; char as a Unicode scalar; and u64/s64 for USize/ISize. Each input site keeps its selected checked constructor, including distinct normalizing choices for the same record, fixed-width wrapping, float negation, text and byte extension and the tested character replacement. The host rejects wrong kinds, malformed fields, non-canonical limbs, negative zero, surrogates and invalid UTF-8 before Lean runs. Rejected refinements leave caller values unchanged; a later valid call succeeds. Copied results project existing Lean values and require no input constructor selection. GenericNat is the concrete GenericCarrier Nat alias: its value field crosses without a proof, each named specialization retains its selected plusOne or plusTwo constructor, and copied results carry no constructor."

edits.current: "subtype": "In WIT, checked nominal values preserve all nineteen tested primitive representations through the Component Model adapter and its 64-bit native Lean host: the unit enum for Unit; bool; u8, u16, u32 and u64; s8, s16, s32 and s64; exact little-endian `list<u32>` limbs for Nat; a record of sign and limbs for Int; f32 and f64 including signed zero; string with embedded NUL; `list<u8>` for ByteArray; char as a Unicode scalar; and u64/s64 for USize/ISize. Each input site keeps its selected checked constructor, including distinct normalizing choices for the same record, fixed-width wrapping, float negation, text and byte extension and the tested character replacement. The host rejects wrong kinds, malformed fields, non-canonical limbs, negative zero, surrogates and invalid UTF-8 before Lean runs. Rejected refinements leave caller values unchanged; a later valid call succeeds. Copied results project existing Lean values and require no input constructor selection. GenericNat is the concrete GenericCarrier Nat alias: its value field crosses without a proof, each named specialization retains its selected plusOne or plusTwo constructor, and copied results carry no constructor."
